personality_one_liner: A structured, trustworthy, and modern business ERP featuring clean data hierarchies, warm terracotta accents, and rigorous RTL readability in both light and dark modes.

spacing.rule: Rigorous padding for dense data; ensure RTL context applies flipped horizontal margins/paddings natively.

do's: Sticky header blur over scrolling KPIs

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Real-time KPI overview and quick function access.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header. 2-column grid for KPIs. Chart/List section full width below.

screens.name: Pro Upgrade
screens.purpose: Display premium features to incentivize upgrade.
screens.layout: Hero layout with metallic pro accents. Vertical list of benefits. Sticky CTA at the bottom.

layout_guidance.Header: Sticky, glassmorphism enabled. Contains screen title (RTL aligned right), subtle avatar or menu icon on left.
layout_guidance.Card: surfaceSecondary, radius md, shadow tier 1. Margins lg around them. Used for customer/debts list items.
layout_guidance.Button: Primary: solid brandPrimary, pill radius. Secondary: brandTertiary bg, onBrandTertiary text. Ghost: transparent with brandPrimary text. Danger: solid error.
layout_guidance.KPI Tile: surfaceSecondary, flex 1 in 2-col row. Large metric (Cairo-Bold 2xl) and muted label (Cairo-Regular sm).
layout_guidance.Bottom Tab Bar: Glassmorphism, inactive icons are muted outlined, active icons are brandPrimary filled.
layout_guidance.Pro Plan Comparison: Hero card with metallic gold 'pro' gradient/accent. Feature list with standard checkmarks. Prominent sticky CTA at bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce RTL layout globally (right-align text, flip chevrons, support I18nManager.isRTL natively).
Use Cairo-Bold for display/headers and Cairo-Regular for text. DO NOT use other font families or simulated weights.
Implement the new dual light/dark theme strictly mapping the 'light' and 'dark' color objects.
Avoid the old moss green completely; stick to the new professional Terracotta/Gold palette.
Use the specific 'pro' and 'onPro' colors to emphasize badges and the Upgrade Pro page.
